name: Liane
differences:
TibiaWiki item page Letter revid 1103612 explicitly says Liane sells Letter for 5 gp after completing the Postman Quest and 8 gp otherwise (itemid 3505; item source_context notes="Price is 5 [[gp]] if you have completed the [[Postman Quest]], 8 gp otherwise.\nLooks the same as an [[Invitation]].
They are used to send letters to other players via the [[Mailbox]]es spread throughout the map. Once sent, they arrive as a [[Stamped Letter]] to the recipient and cannot be rewritten or reused.
\n''See also [[Mailbox]] and [[Sending Letters]].''"; buyfrom='Auron, Benjamin, Chemar, Chrystal, Dove, Fyodor, Gnomailion, Herbert, Jakahr, Kaya, Liane, Lokur, Murim, Nelly, Ninos, Olrik, Ray, Redward, Rock In A Hard Place, Wally'). The linked native player-buy offer is a static 8 gp (content/services/trade/trade-00000-00323.json:1#/records/181/declaration/offers/1), so the unconditional base price agrees; the after-quest discount condition is not represented. Native offers are projected without a character-conditioned unit-price field (crates/gameplay/npc/src/npc_talk.rs:339-344), trade validates the requested price against the static server offer (crates/gameplay/dispatch/src/gameplay_transport/npc_command.rs:411-420), and durability receives offer.unit_price (crates/gameplay/dispatch/src/gameplay_transport/npc_trade_command.rs:315-326). The Postman predicate in this trace is used for paid travel only (crates/gameplay/durability/src/durability/npc_travel/paid.rs:98-102). Actor reachability and live quest-state fulfillment were not checked. This is a condition-level discrepancy, not a flat 5-versus-8 price conflict.

TibiaWiki item page Parcel revid 1042461 explicitly says Liane sells Parcel for 10 gp after completing the Postman Quest and 15 gp otherwise (itemid 3503; item source_context notes="Looks the same as a [[Package of Potions]] and a [[Parcel (Watchtower)]].
Price is 10 [[gp]] if the [[Postman Quest]] has been completed, 15 gp otherwise. To send a parcel it must have a [[label]] in it with the name of the receiver written on the first row, and then placed on a [[mailbox]]. Once a parcel is sent, it is stamped [[Image:Stamped Parcel.gif]] and can no longer be sent through the mail; however, these used (stamped) parcels are widely used as ''ladders'' by stacking 3 of these to reach higher places that otherwise can be reached only by using the [[Instant Spells|spell]] [[Levitate]]. The weight is increased to 18.10 [[oz]] with the [[label]] in it that is required to send it. {{seealso|Mailbox|Sending Parcels}}."; buyfrom='Auron, Benjamin, Chemar, Chrystal, Dove, Elgar, Ezean, Fyodor, Gnomailion, Herbert, Jakahr, Kaya, Liane, Lokur, Murim, Nelly, Ninos, Olrik, Ray, Redward, Robson:15, Rock In A Hard Place, Wally'). The linked native player-buy offer is a static 15 gp (content/services/trade/trade-00000-00323.json:1#/records/181/declaration/offers/0), so the unconditional base price agrees; the after-quest discount condition is not represented. Native offers are projected without a character-conditioned unit-price field (crates/gameplay/npc/src/npc_talk.rs:339-344), trade validates the requested price against the static server offer (crates/gameplay/dispatch/src/gameplay_transport/npc_command.rs:411-420), and durability receives offer.unit_price (crates/gameplay/dispatch/src/gameplay_transport/npc_trade_command.rs:315-326). The Postman predicate in this trace is used for paid travel only (crates/gameplay/durability/src/durability/npc_travel/paid.rs:98-102). Actor reachability and live quest-state fulfillment were not checked. This is a condition-level discrepancy, not a flat 10-versus-15 price conflict.

TibiaWiki item page reports Player buys from NPC for `Parcel` (page item id 3503) with price scenario(s) Wiki scenario if the [[Postman Quest]] has been completed: 10, but the linked native Trade service static at 15; native unit price matches otherwise (the [[Postman Quest]] has not been completed); no NPC-specific price override or quest gate was found in the indexed Rust references, and `npc_command.rs:400-433` commits the linked service unit price. Price is 10 [[gp]] if the [[Postman Quest]] has been completed, 15 gp otherwise. To send a parcel it must have a [[label]] in it with the name of the receiver written on the first row, and then placed on a [[mailbox]]. Once a parcel is sent, it is stamped [[Image:Stamped Parcel.gif]] and can no longer be sent through the mail; however, these used (stamped) parcels are widely used as ''ladders'' by stacking 3 of these to reach higher places that otherwise can be reached only by using the [[Instant Spells|spell]] [[Levitate]]. The weight is increased to 18.10 [[oz]] with the [[label]] in it that is required to send it. {{seealso|Mailbox|Sending Parcels}}."; buyfrom='Auron, Benjamin, Chemar, Chrystal, Dove, Elgar, Ezean, Fyodor, Gnomailion, Herbert, Jakahr, Kaya, Liane, Lokur, Murim, Nelly, Ninos, Olrik, Ray, Redward, Robson:15, Rock In A Hard Place, Wally'). The linked native player-buy offer is a static 15 gp (content/services/trade/trade-00000-00323.json:1#/records/33/declaration/offers/0), so the unconditional base price agrees; the after-quest discount condition is not represented. Native offers are projected without a character-conditioned unit-price field (crates/gameplay/npc/src/npc_talk.rs:339-344), trade validates the requested price against the static server offer (crates/gameplay/dispatch/src/gameplay_transport/npc_command.rs:411-420), and durability receives offer.unit_price (crates/gameplay/dispatch/src/gameplay_transport/npc_trade_command.rs:315-326). The Postman predicate in this trace is used for paid travel only (crates/gameplay/durability/src/durability/npc_travel/paid.rs:98-102).
